editorial:
Imagine losing your dad out of nowhere and then feeling like the whole world has turned into a nightmare. That is exactly where you find yourself when you start this movie. You follow a young woman who is trying to handle her grief, but things get weird fast. The vibe is heavy and creepy, making you feel like someone is always watching from the corners of the room. It is not just about jump scares; it is about that uneasy feeling that nothing is actually okay, even when you are safe inside your own home.

The acting feels real, which makes the scary parts hit way harder. While the story starts a bit slow, the twists at the end keep you glued to the screen. If you like movies that mess with your head, you will love this. Just make sure the lights are off for the full experience.
endingExplained: You find out that the main character was not just imagining things. The twist reveals that her father's death was not an accident, and a dark family secret was hiding in plain sight. In the final scenes, she realizes her mother is not who she seems. The movie wraps up with a shocking confrontation where the cycle of violence continues, leaving you wondering if anyone truly escaped the nightmare or if they are all trapped.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological horror and family secrets.
